items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid on the WAI-ARIA date grid pattern with no dependencies (Date + Intl): single and range selection, controlled or uncontrolled, min/max and disabled days, multiple months, keyboard navigation, renderDay slot and a directional month slide.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. No dependencies: Date + Intl only, following the WAI-ARIA date grid pattern. Locale defaults to ko-KR; week start comes from Intl.Locale weekInfo (Monday fallback), override with weekStartsOn. Set lang on the wrapper for CJK leading. mode="range" selects start then end (a click before the start swaps them). Keys: arrows day/week, PageUp/PageDown month, Shift+PageUp/PageDown year, Home/End week start/end, Enter/Space select; disabled days are skipped. Use minDate, maxDate, isDateDisabled, numberOfMonths and renderDay (slot for event dots). The month slides with yorha motion tokens (reduced = opacity-only fade, off = instant) and the selected day wipes in dark.
